focus_area: Human oversight protection and agent containment
recommendation: Regular security assessments and red teaming
aws_service: Amazon S3 / Amazon Bedrock Guardrails / Amazon Bedrock AgentCore / Amazon CloudWatch
guidance: Untested security controls degrade quietly as techniques evolve and configurations drift. A combination of continuous automated scanning and periodic human-led red team exercises validates that guardrails, detection rules, and response procedures still work against current attacks.
how_to_check: • You run automated security scanning continuously against agent deployments (on each deploy and on schedule) and conduct human-led red team exercises on a regular cadence with scenarios targeting agent manipulation, including prompt injection, goal hijacking, and tool misuse. • You document findings, track them to remediation, and use them to update security controls and detection rules. For more information, see the AGENTSEC07-BP05 documentation.
